title: The Civilizational Risks of a UAP Technology Arms Race: Nonhuman Technology and Global Security
author: Marik von Rennenkampff
summary: The Sol Foundation policy paper examines the civilizational and geopolitical risks that could follow if states were competing to exploit advanced technology of alleged nonhuman origin. It focuses on secrecy, deterrence, strategic instability and international control, treating a UAP technology arms race as a consequential policy scenario rather than evidence that any government actually possesses nonhuman technology.
